svg.aria-label: Your AI agent reaches the store two ways: the hosted MCP server at store.kadal.cc/mcp, signed in with OAuth and nothing to install, or kadal-store mcp on your computer over stdio. You run the same kadal-store in a terminal. Both act on store.kadal.cc with your own sign-in: the shop and your library. A buy link opens a review page, where only you can pay.
